name: Server-Stored Reusable Event Fragment ("part" doctype)
description: A named, server-stored action list (not a dataset of records, and not a full page) fetched via action.filldataset with proc:"PWA.LoadLayout", args.doctype:"part", args.docno:"<fragment-key>" into a dataset named after the event (e.g. fapoEvent1). The fetched action list is then spliced into other action arrays the same way molecule.stored-action-formula is: as a bare "[datasetName]" string element (commonly inside a grid row control's onFocusOut). Use this when an action sequence needs to be shared across multiple pages/doctypes server-side, rather than molecule.stored-action-formula which is page-local and defined in whenload.
sourceRefs: examples/purchase-order-fapo-fapi.md (_fapi-whenload-events: fetches docno:"fapo-event-1" into dset "fapoEvent1"; _fapo-event-1: the fetched fragment itself, referenced as "[fapoEvent1]" inside PURDET_QTY/PURDET_RATE onFocusOut arrays)

docno.description: The fragment's key in the server-side layout store, e.g. "fapo-event-1".

dset.description: Local dataset name to hold the fetched action list, e.g. "fapoEvent1".

usageNote: Fetch once in whenload alongside any molecule.stored-action-formula definitions (order matters if the fragment itself ends by invoking a stored formula, as _fapo-event-1 does with "[calcformula]"). The fragment's own body may recompute per-row tax/amount fields via fillmultidataset + mergedatasetarray before delegating to the page-local formula for header-level totals.
